description: This file defines a Go struct for configuring Kubernetes container lifecycle hooks, including PostStart, PreStop, and StopSignal, with associated builder methods.

classes.name: LifecycleApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration struct for Kubernetes container lifecycle hooks, supporting chaining methods for setting PostStart, PreStop, and StopSignal.

methods.name: Lifecycle
methods.description: Constructor function that creates a new instance of LifecycleApplyConfiguration.

methods.name: WithPostStart
methods.description: Sets the PostStart configuration and returns the modified object for chaining.

methods.name: WithPreStop
methods.description: Sets the PreStop configuration and returns the modified object for chaining.

methods.name: WithStopSignal
methods.description: Sets the StopSignal configuration and returns the modified object for chaining.
